description: Rubric for the app's health score. Every threshold comes from an official source; the weights, the scale and the grade bands are the app's own product decisions. See docs/health-score.md.
basis: Per 100 g, or per 100 ml for drinks. Label values are normalised first.

salt.note: Low is Japan's 低ナトリウム claim (sodium ≤ 120 mg) converted to salt: 120 × 2.54 ÷ 1000 = 0.30 g.

low.title: 食品表示基準 別表第十二 (nutrient-content claims: 低 / 控えめ)
low.note: Same values as docs/japanese-nutrition-label-spec.md §9. They match the UK 'low' (green) thresholds exactly.

high.title: Guide to creating a front of pack (FoP) nutrition label for pre-packed products sold through retail outlets (2016), Table 1
high.authority: UK Department of Health / Food Standards Agency
high.note: The 'high' (red) per-100 g and per-100 ml thresholds. The guide's per-portion red rule (> 30% / 40% of the reference intake) isn't used, because Japan has no standard portion. UK guidance, not Japanese or EU law.

positives.title: 食品表示基準 別表第十二 (nutrient-content claims: 含む / 高)
positives.note: 'Source of' and 'high in' thresholds for protein and fibre, as in docs/japanese-nutrition-label-spec.md §9.
